title: The farmer who sustains many lives
literal_meaning: The cultivator sustains a hundred thousand lives.
meaning_odia: ଚଷା ନିଜ ପାଇଁ ମାତ୍ର ନୁହେଁ, ଅନେକ ଜୀବଙ୍କ ଖାଦ୍ୟ ପାଇଁ ଚାଷ କରନ୍ତି—ଏହା କଥାଟିର ପ୍ରଶଂସାମୂଳକ ଭାବ। ଲକ୍ଷେ କହି ତାଙ୍କ ଶ୍ରମର ବ୍ୟାପକ ଉପକାରକୁ ବଡ଼ କରି ଦେଖାଯାଇଛି।
explanation: The saying honours the cultivator by linking one occupation to the nourishment of many lives. Its large number gives the praise breadth. Read editorially, the line makes the shared benefit of agricultural labour visible beyond the farmer’s own household.
usage_example: Original imagined example: At a community meal, a speaker thanks those who grew the food and quotes the saying to recognise how their labour supports others.
cultural_context: ଚଷା and ପୋଷା make a compact rhyme that joins an occupation to its nourishing role. ଜୀବ gives that role a wide reach, while ଲକ୍ଷେ magnifies the number of lives sustained.

witnesses.locator: Page17, third complete saying, single line ଚଷା, ଲକ୍ଷେ ଜୀବ ପୋଷା.
witnesses.note: Rendered upload inspected17November2026; wording and comma retained. Literal hundred thousand preserves ଲକ୍ଷେ; commentary reads it as emphatic abundance, not a measured count.
